reason: I buy lighting from Wayfair, Amazon or Lowe's because I know how returns and delivery work, and I have never heard of Nora Furnish. UL listing numbers and free returns are good signs, but with almost no reviews and 2 to 3 weeks delivery I would stick with the big retailers for my Airbnb refresh.
objection: Brand new store with hardly any reviews, so I don't know if they'll actually honor the returns or if my electrician will have problems with the fixture. At $360 for one pendant, I'd rather not be the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A pile of verified reviews from real buyers, or the same fixture listed on Amazon or Wayfair where I already trust the returns.
